note: Murray County park on the west side of Lake Sarah west of Slayton, off paved County Road 30. Open grassy back-in sites in a field set back from the lake behind the park road and a shoreline tree belt; boat landing, dock, swimming area, accessible fishing pier and playground beside them. A campground host is on site. --Claude
